Transcript text identifies James Callister as Chief Investment Officer while structured segment role metadata labels his speech CFO.

projection_law: When a nonblank segment role is compatible with any transcript-local title evidence, preserve that existing role string. When segment role is blank and an exact same-revision roster/title declaration is the support, preserve the normalized source title phrase itself; do not collapse it to generic Management and do not invent an abbreviation absent from source. Never truncate a source title to satisfy a consumer bound: if a later production consumer cannot represent the frozen supported title safely, that is a contract/consumer blocker to adjudicate before publication.
